subject: Post-call recap + Q3 timing check — LuminaHealth AI pilot
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@luminahealth.com>, Alex Boone <aboone@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T15:12:00Z
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed next steps (LuminaHealth)

Hi Samir / Alex —

Really appreciate the time today. Quick recap from our 45-min discovery so we have one source of truth and clear next steps: 

- Main priority: reduce assistant latency on patient triage flows and cut inference cost per session; primary constraint is HIPAA-aligned deployment and auditability.
- Desired outcome: 6-week pilot to validate throughput and answer quality regressions on triage prompts; success metric: <=200ms median token latency and <=10% change in triage acceptance vs baseline.
- Decision/approval path: Product -> Security -> Procurement. Samir estimated Product + Security sync this month, Procurement expects procurement window at EoQ.

Suggested next steps:
1) I attached a one-page mutual action plan (MAP_v1.xlsx) with owner names and dates — can you confirm owners for Security & Procurement?
2) We’ll share a starter pricing estimate and SOC2 summary (attached pricing-estimate.xlsx) for procurement prep.
3) Tech sync: propose Thu 9/9 or Mon 9/13 (30 min) to go over integration and VPC options.

If the timelines you mentioned have shifted, can you flag that here so we can adjust the MAP?

Thanks — I’ll follow up with calendar invites after I hear which slot works.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx), pricing-estimate.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Samir Patel <samir@luminahealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Boone <aboone@luminahealth.com>
Date: 2027-09-02T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed next steps (LuminaHealth)

Neha —

Thanks for the tidy recap. A few quick notes:
- Product (me) and Security (Alex) are aligned on the pilot scope — we want to validate latency and safety filters.
- Procurement: likely to push pricing review to the final two weeks of the quarter. That said, if we can get a simple SOC2 summary and a clear pilot price, I can try to create bandwidth to get Procurement earlier.

Can you also include a short note about data residency and retention in the next packet? Our security team will want that up front.

I’m available 9/9 for a tech sync — please send an invite.

Samir
Samir Patel
VP Product | LuminaHealth
samir@luminahealth.com | 617-555-9987

Hi Samir — looping back as we didn’t get confirmation on owners or the tech sync invite. With the quarter wrapping up, I wanted to check if the priority or timeline has changed on your side.

Short options:
- Still green: Security + Procurement owners confirmed, we proceed with 6-week pilot starting early Oct.
- Prioritized later: you push pilot to next quarter — if so, what month should we re-check?
- Need help: I can escalate to Ben (cc’d) to discuss limited pilot credits or an accelerated procurement packet.

If useful, here’s a quick link to our SOC2 summary and data residency notes: https://drive.redwood.com/soc2/summary (also attaching redwood-soc2-summary.pdf in my next note).

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-28T09:04:00Z
Subject: Internal: LuminaHealth — EoQ push recommendation

Ben / Marissa — quick internal note on LuminaHealth (deal LUM-2027-0930):

Summary: Product & Security are engaged, Procurement likely to wait until the final EoQ window. We haven’t heard back after the 9/22 nudge.

Recommendation: propose a targeted EoQ push — offer a 10% pilot credit (applied to first-month usage) and prioritize a 30-min procurement packet review with our Solutions Architect this week. Credit can be pitched as a short, rev-generating pilot with fast rollback — helps remove procurement friction.

Ask: can you confirm approval for the pilot credit and whether Legal needs to pre-clear any deviations for a pilot credit? If approved, I’ll schedule an expedited packet review and update the MAP.

Neha
